structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. It's a long dark list of near-identical rows from insurance and investment houses. The only ones that looked calm to me were the "כספי (שקלי)" and "אג"ח" tracks with 0% מניות: about 4.4% over 3 years, and the company takes about 0.57–0.6% a year. I can't tell from this page whether that's better than my deposit, so I'll ask you, and maybe the bank, before I move a shekel.

stuck.where: Top of screen 1, the row of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: Choices like "עוקב מדד s&p 500", "עוקב מדד מניות" and "הלכה איסלאמית". I didn't know what to press, so I left it on "הכל 143" and just scrolled.

stuck.where: Column "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח" with the coloured rings
stuck.why: Each row has two numbers next to a turquoise and a yellow dot, plus a ring. I had to look back and forth to match the colours, and they look alike on the dark background. I never worked out what the ring means.
Most rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number, so I couldn't compare them. I didn't understand whether that means the track is new.
Row after row, the same words again: "מההפקדה", "מהחיסכון", "מניות", "מט"ח", "3 שנים", "5 שנים". I got tired and stopped after screen 4.

used: Title "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the sentence that "דמי הניהול הם הממוצע שנגבה בפועל ב־2025"
The orange warning "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026"
Company heading rows (הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס) with their range of "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון"
Rows "כספי (שקלי)": 0% מניות, about 4.25%–4.62% over 3 years, 0.57%–0.71% מהחיסכון
Rows "אג"ח סחיר" and "אג"ח ממשלות", which has "עוד לא דווח"
skimmed: Numbers in the "נכסים בסוף ספטמבר 2026" column (מיליון/מיליארד)
The share rows, "מניות" and "עוקב מדד", with their 20%+ returns; I didn't want them
The 4- and 5-digit numbers in the "קופה" column
skipped: Top menu (מדריך, חוקים וכללים, השוואה למטרה...)
The arrows at the left end of each row
unsure_meaning: s&p 500 / S&P500 (I read it letter by letter)
עוקב מדד, as in "עוקב מדד מניות" and "עוקב מדד גמיש" (to me מדד is the price index)
כספי (שקלי): is that like a deposit?
סחיר, as in "אג"ח סחיר" and "משולב סחיר"
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a return
not_found: My bank or any bank; only insurance and investment companies (I didn't know מור and אנליסט)
Any comparison to a bank deposit, or a sentence saying which tracks are safe or guaranteed
A plain sentence on what kupat gemel lehashkaa is and whether I can take the money out
A box where I could type my own amount and see how much I would pay in fees in shekels

findings.what: Hard to read for me: a dark background, thin light lettering and dotted underlines on every number, with a busy screen full of numbers
Every row repeats the same words and colour key ("מהחיסכון/מההפקדה", "מניות/מט"ח" with dots, "3 שנים/5 שנים"), so I reread them on each row; once in the header would have been enough
The safest-looking tracks are scattered among the share tracks, under each company separately, and there is no way to see them together
English letters and jargon in the filters on the very first screen
The two percentages have to be matched to coloured dots and a ring, and turquoise and yellow are hard to tell apart on the dark background
Many tracks show "פחות מ־3 שנים" and some show "עוד לא דווח", so they can't be compared
The orange warning that the data was not updated worried me before I had started
Nothing explains whether any track is as safe as a deposit
